name: molio2-editor
description: Desktop viewer and editor for Molio 2.0 specification files

scripts.test:raw: npm run build -w @molio2-editor/core && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.package: npm run build -w @molio2-editor/core && npm run package -w @molio2-editor/app
scripts.package:mac: npm run build -w @molio2-editor/core && npm run package:mac -w @molio2-editor/app
scripts.package:win: npm run build -w @molio2-editor/core && npm run package:win -w @molio2-editor/app
scripts.package:linux: npm run build -w @molio2-editor/core && npm run package:linux -w @molio2-editor/app
scripts.package:dir: npm run build -w @molio2-editor/core && npm run package:dir -w @molio2-editor/app
